title: feat: classify pull requests with project work type
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Bug / Feature / Task classification for PRs and writes it to the Dev project’s Work type field.
- Reuses linked issue types as scope-checked hints and shares the lookup with Source attribution; failed lookups stop classification.
- Preserves native issue Type/Priority and clears Work type for unclassified promotion PRs.
- Runs six regression tests in PR CI, including linked-hint prompts and the organizer’s clear-field path.

Setup complete: Dev now has **Work type** with **Bug, Feature, Task**. Three real PR organizer dry-runs passed against that field without writing item values.

Validation: six unit tests, authenticated Bug/Feature/Task dry-runs, native issue dry-run, syntax/diff and workflow checks. Backfill code stays local with a seven-day default; it was not applied. News/frontend changes are outside this PR.

Addresses #16647; merge-time gist enrichment remains follow-up work.

gist.headline: A label for the work
gist.blurb: The PR organizer sorts work into Bug, Feature, and Task. Promotion PRs that don't fit get a clean slate instead of a guess.
gist.summary: The PR organizer classifies pull requests into the Dev project's Work type field as Bug, Feature, or Task, using scope-checked linked issue types as hints while preserving native issue Type and Priority.
gist.impact: Maintainers get consistent Work type values for classified PRs; unclassified promotion PRs have the field cleared rather than carrying a misleading value.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy project-organizing desk with three pixel cards labeled Bug, Feature, and Task. Polli sorts a PR card while a small code-plant grows beside the terminal; an empty card slot represents the cleared field for unclassified promotion PRs.
